lessons.summary: Don't overrate hosts/favorites — keep devigged 1X2 line
lessons.action: Use devigged anchor as-is; do not shade toward larger favorite number.

lessons.summary: Even matchups carry heavy draw mass
lessons.action: Don't overprice either win or star-goal when win bands are 40-60.

lessons.summary: Strict 'more than' markets lose on ties (tie-trap)
lessons.action: Use §5.4 Bessel exact table for all comparison markets. P(tie) is rich; 50 is the richest well.

lessons.summary: Player 1+ SOT >> player goal in market value
lessons.action: Prioritise SOT markets for player props. Higher RBP opportunity.
Stay near base rates: pen/red ~28%, penalty only ~17%. Absorb bad Briers; don't shade.

lessons.summary: T-floor for even matchups — never drag T >0.1 below anchor
lessons.action: PROVISIONAL — not an operative rule. For no-anchor matches: +0.2-0.3 to base rate T.

lessons.summary: Striker SOT: discount in team λ allocation (merged into L10)
lessons.action: Adjust λ allocation within team, not final output. See L10.

lessons.summary: Correlation cap: >4 markets sharing one latent axis → batched MC
lessons.action: Proactively run L8 Monte Carlo for near-horizon matches where >4 markets share one axis (goals, SOT, corners). QAT-SUI is canonical example.
Use Bessel table for HT tie. Cap at 47 for T≥2.2. For T<2.2, can go up to 47-50.

lessons.summary: 56-70% band overpriced — ran -16.8pt hot at n=18@118
lessons.action: INPUT-SIDE only: striker SOT band lowered to 52-64 (was 60-72). Modeled-prob driver gate for 56-70 range. NO output floor/ceiling.
PROVISIONAL — track; do not bump outputs. Coherent mirror of L10.

lessons.summary: Win markets run hot (n=10@118, 0.303 Brier vs 0.209 expected)
lessons.action: INPUT-SIDE: firmer Dixon-Coles draw inflation + more fundamentals weight in 40-60 win band. Symmetric: low underdogs over-win, modest favs miss. NO floor.
Rank by weighted RBP not raw Brier. Best match = CAN-BIH +60.67 RBP (beat crowd across markets).
~1200 excess goalless games + fat 4+ tail vs pure Poisson(1.305). Use Dixon-Coles ±3 correction cap. Strengthens draw inflation.
Crowd over-prices mid-tier names, under-prices dominant favs. NEVER a fade rule — only allocates extra research to plausibly biased markets.

prime_directives.D1: Zero-miss: No match reaches T-12h uncovered. Depth Pass inside T-24h.
prime_directives.D2: Calibration is strategy: Submit true probability. Never shade to/from crowd.
prime_directives.D3: Integers 1-99 only. Avoid exactly 50. Revise via update_prediction.
prime_directives.D4: Never fabricate. Missing data → base-rate fallback, label LOW, still submit.
prime_directives.D6: All writes via submit_predictions_batch (≤50/call). 429 → back off 30-60s.
prime_directives.D8: All times in IST (UTC+5:30). NA kickoffs roll into next IST day.
prime_directives.D9: Numbers, sources, drivers. No filler. Quantify uncertainty.
prime_directives.D10: No static ledgers. Pull live from list_predictions/list_results each session.
prime_directives.D11: Audit guardrail: PROVISIONAL not operative until ACTIVE (n≥8). No floors from single sessions.
prime_directives.D12: RBP-first: rank by weighted RBP. Submit honest p; research allocation by crowd-edge.
